result_text:
The reports module compiles and the landscape tests pass (quiet Maven printed no errors). I did not commit.

Changes, all in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/landscape/statichtml/`:

- **`LandscapeContributorsReport.java`**: removed the `contributorsListLimit` cut from the contributor table, so `contributors.html`, `contributors-recent.html`, and the bots and teams pages list everyone, in the same most-recent-first order. I also removed the "The list is limited to N items (out of M)." note.
- **`LandscapeReportContributorsTab.java`**: removed the `.limit(...)` on `recentContributors` in the bar chart, so there is one bar per recently active contributor.

`contributorsListLimit` is still in `LandscapeConfiguration` and still loads from `config.json`, but nothing reads it now. I did not check the rendered HTML output by running a report, so that is untested beyond compilation and the existing tests.
